titulo: Quiz — Praise that reaches the kitchen
introPt: A traveller sends a compliment to the kitchen and gets a cold dish replaced.

dialogo.es: La pasta era buonissima, complimenti al cuoco.
dialogo.pt: The pasta was outstanding, compliments to the cook.

dialogo.es: Glielo dico subito. È mia madre che cucina.
dialogo.pt: I'll tell her right away. It's my mother who cooks.

dialogo.es: Mi dispiace tantissimo, glielo cambio subito.
dialogo.pt: I'm terribly sorry, I'll change it right away.

perguntas.pergunta: What makes a compliment travel to the kitchen?
How should a complaint be built?
opcoes: Apology, then the problem, then another apology
Scusi plus the fact, then stop
perguntas.explica: The shorter the sentence, the faster the fix.

opcoes: It buries the fact and signals you expect resistance
perguntas.explica: A flat warm factual sentence is read as normal.

opcoes: Ordinary words, all stronger than 'very good'
perguntas.explica: Any of the three beats 'very good'.
Places that feed the same people weekly measure work in return visits.
